decisions.reason: The remedy corrects logging composition and qualifies the existing isolated consumer and CI gates, without creating or extending a process artifact.
Retaining the actual failure and using existing bounded executable phase diagnostics for causal correction requests no new process artifact, and RQA9-001 remains unresolved.

The proposed bounded stage/call/deadline receipts are diagnostic output within the existing executable fixture and inventory-child lifecycle, rather than a new process inventory, ledger, report or CI gate, and do not close the observed failure.
The remedy changes the genuine public logging composition and removes the direct dependency while preserving existing policy and gates; it requires no new process artifact or exception.

The remedy completes existing production, causal-diagnosis and acceptance obligations rather than adding a new evidence regime; current RQA10 and historical RQA9 failures remain unresolved despite scoped protocol-control progress.

Removing the direct edge through the authorized public port is an implementation remedy; the historical conditional reference to separate ADR authorization neither requires a new process artifact nor authorizes an amendment, waiver or exception widening.

scope: All six concerns retained, no waiver or new process artifact; runtime diagnostic proposals accepted within existing fixture
